description: We're 'Kayseri Yağlamaları',a group that has 6 members.We love creating solutions using technology.We love doing research about space.We love designing,also we're good at analyzing data.And that's us!
summary: As the group,Kayseri Yağlamaları, we developed a health monitor for astronauts.In space,sometimes people can't see what's happening in their body and because of this they can't be ready for the coming health problem.In our monitor, they can see everything of the astronaut's body.How much did he/she sleep,how much bone density does she/he lost, how much nutrition does her/his body have.Also,if the monitor detects a problem in their body, it gives red alarms.And also,they can try it as a simulation and see what happens if a astronaut starts to have bone density losing.It is important because it always follows astronout's body and if there is a problem in their body they can see it early and They can take precautions to prevent the occurrence of more serious health problems.
details: Our monitor is like a simulation.A simulation that shows a mission which is happening in more than 100+ days,what can happen in human body.It has a button,that says 'Start simulation' and after that,you see what happens.If you want, you can make the body values low or more and see what happens.The benefits of our monitor are, with this, you can see what happening in an astonaut's body, if the nutrional or body values are low and how much body value do we need to have to don't have any health problem in space,you can see this early and you can know what to do! Our impact is with this monitor,making astronauts know how to protect their health and body in space and returning Earth with less health damage.We used our life's technology,AI while developing our project.Our project is creative with you can see everything what's happening in astronaut's body and if there's any problem in the body it makes a red alarm in the shape of body (there is an image that shows the body in monitor) It showes where is the problem and that part of bodybecomes red.And you can see what is the problem and take a prevention.Our team considered which nutrient and bodily value deficiencies lead to health problems,we took notes about that and added to our monitor.And the crew is our team!
